question: “If you love hot cakes and you love ice creams, then you will surely love hot cake ice cream.” Which fallacy is committed in the above argument?
explanation: Fallacy of Composition wrongly concludes the whole will have properties of its parts — liking ketchup and liking ice cream separately doesn't mean the combination will be liked.

question_data.stem: “If you love hot cakes and you love ice creams, then you will surely love hot cake ice cream.” Which fallacy is committed in the above argument?

option_explanations.D: Hasty Generalisation draws conclusions from insufficient sample — not the error here.
